# Exported API of pkg/... (the SDK, the hub and the framework hooks). Generated by `go run ./scripts/apisnap -w`; CI fails when it is stale.

package connector // import "github.com/velixio/paymux/pkg/connector"

const (
	OutcomeOK           = "ok"
	OutcomeClientError  = "client_error"
	OutcomeRateLimited  = "rate_limited"
	OutcomeServerError  = "server_error"
	OutcomeTimeout      = "timeout"
	OutcomeNetworkError = "network_error"
)

const CallBodyLimit = 64 << 10

var (
	ErrNotFound           = errors.New("connector: not found")
	ErrInvalidCredentials = errors.New("connector: invalid credentials")
	ErrTemporary          = errors.New("connector: temporary failure")
	ErrUnsupported        = errors.New("connector: unsupported")
	ErrRejected           = errors.New("connector: rejected by the provider")
	ErrInvalidSignature   = errors.New("connector: webhook signature missing, wrong or stale")
	ErrUnsigned           = errors.New("connector: webhook event type is not signed by the provider")
	ErrInvalidReturn      = errors.New("connector: return signature invalid")
	ErrMandateLimit       = errors.New("connector: amount exceeds mandate limit")
)

var ErrPrivateAddress = errors.New("connector: target is a private or special-use address")

func IsPrivateIP(ip net.IP) bool

func Lookup(name string) (Factory, Info, bool)

func NewHTTPClient(o HTTPOptions) *http.Client

func Register(name string, f Factory, info Info)

func ReportDecodeError(resp *http.Response, err error)

func ResetRegistryForTest()

func ValidOrigin(o string) bool

func WithAttemptHook(ctx context.Context, fn func(*http.Request)) context.Context

type Beneficiary struct {
	Name          string `json:"name"`
	AccountNumber string `json:"account_number,omitempty"`
	IFSC          string `json:"ifsc,omitempty"`
	UPI           string `json:"upi,omitempty"`
	Email         string `json:"email,omitempty"`
	Phone         string `json:"phone,omitempty"`
}

type BillingMode string

const (
	ProviderManaged   BillingMode = "provider_managed"
	MerchantTriggered BillingMode = "merchant_triggered"
)

type CallFailure string

const (
	FailTransport CallFailure = "transport"
	FailTimeout   CallFailure = "timeout"
	FailStatus    CallFailure = "status"
	FailDecode    CallFailure = "decode"
)

type CallRecord struct {
	Method            string
	URL               url.URL
	Status            int
	Duration          time.Duration
	Failure           CallFailure
	Err               error
	Attempt           int
	WillRetry         bool
	RequestHeader     http.Header
	ResponseHeader    http.Header
	RequestBody       []byte
	ResponseBody      []byte
	RequestTruncated  bool
	ResponseTruncated bool
}

type CallRecorder func(ctx context.Context, c CallRecord)

type Canceler interface {
	CancelCheckout(ctx context.Context, ref PaymentRef) error
}

type Capability string

const (
	CapRefund              Capability = "refund"
	CapDisputeRead         Capability = "dispute_read"
	CapDisputeRespond      Capability = "dispute_respond"
	CapList                Capability = "list"
	CapSettle              Capability = "settle"
	CapCancel              Capability = "cancel"
	CapSubscriptionManager Capability = "subscription_manager"
	CapMandateManager      Capability = "mandate_manager"
	CapPayout              Capability = "payout"
	CapOAuth               Capability = "oauth"
	CapWebhookConfig       Capability = "webhook_config"
)

type CardDetails struct {
	Last4         string `json:"last4,omitempty"`
	Network       string `json:"network,omitempty"`
	Funding       string `json:"funding,omitempty"`
	Issuer        string `json:"issuer,omitempty"`
	Country       string `json:"country,omitempty"`
	International *bool  `json:"international,omitempty"`
	EMI           *bool  `json:"emi,omitempty"`
	SubType       string `json:"sub_type,omitempty"`
}

type ChargeRequest struct {
	Mandate     MandateRef `json:"mandate"`
	ProviderRef string     `json:"provider_ref"`
	Amount      int64      `json:"amount"`
	Currency    string     `json:"currency"`
}

type CheckoutHoster interface{ CheckoutHosts() CheckoutHosts }

type CheckoutHosts struct {
	Script   []string `json:"script,omitempty"`
	Frame    []string `json:"frame,omitempty"`
	Form     []string `json:"form,omitempty"`
	Connect  []string `json:"connect,omitempty"`
	Img      []string `json:"img,omitempty"`
	Redirect []string `json:"redirect,omitempty"`
	Self     string   `json:"-"`
}

func HostsOf(c Connector) CheckoutHosts

type CheckoutRequest struct {
	PaymentID   string            `json:"payment_id"`
	AttemptID   string            `json:"attempt_id"`
	AppID       string            `json:"app_id"`
	ProviderRef string            `json:"provider_ref"`
	Amount      int64             `json:"amount"`
	Currency    string            `json:"currency"`
	Description string            `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Customer    Customer          `json:"customer"`
	Metadata    map[string]string `json:"metadata,omitempty"`
}

type CheckoutResult struct {
	ProviderOrderID string     `json:"provider_order_id,omitempty"`
	NextAction      NextAction `json:"next_action"`
	ExpiresAt       int64      `json:"expires_at,omitempty"`
}

type ConnectionTester interface {
	TestConnection(ctx context.Context) error
}

type Connector interface {
	Info() Info
	CreateCheckout(ctx context.Context, req CheckoutRequest) (CheckoutResult, error)
	HandleReturn(ctx context.Context, req ReturnRequest) (ReturnResult, error)
	VerifyWebhook(ctx context.Context, req WebhookRequest) error
	ParseWebhook(ctx context.Context, req WebhookRequest) ([]Notification, error)
	FetchPayment(ctx context.Context, ref PaymentRef) (PaymentSnapshot, error)
}

type Cursor string

type Customer struct {
	Name  string `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Email string `json:"email,omitempty"`
	Phone string `json:"phone,omitempty"`
}

type Deps struct {
	HTTP   *http.Client
	KV     KV
	Clock  func() time.Time
	Logger *slog.Logger
	URLs   URLs
}

func (d Deps) Now() time.Time

type DisputeReader interface {
	ListDisputes(ctx context.Context, tr TimeRange, cur Cursor) (Page[DisputeSnapshot], error)
	FetchDispute(ctx context.Context, ref DisputeRef) (DisputeSnapshot, error)
}

type DisputeRef struct {
	ProviderDisputeID string `json:"provider_dispute_id"`
}

type DisputeResponder interface {
	AcceptDispute(ctx context.Context, ref DisputeRef) error
	SubmitEvidence(ctx context.Context, ref DisputeRef, ev Evidence) error
}

type DisputeSnapshot struct {
	ProviderDisputeID string        `json:"provider_dispute_id"`
	ProviderPaymentID string        `json:"provider_payment_id"`
	Status            DisputeStatus `json:"status"`
	RawStatus         string        `json:"raw_status"`
	Phase             string        `json:"phase,omitempty"`
	Reason            string        `json:"reason,omitempty"`
	Amount            int64         `json:"amount"`
	Currency          string        `json:"currency"`
	DueBy             int64         `json:"due_by,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt         int64         `json:"created_at,omitempty"`
}

type DisputeStatus string

const (
	DisputeNeedsResponse DisputeStatus = "needs_response"
	DisputeUnderReview   DisputeStatus = "under_review"
	DisputeWon           DisputeStatus = "won"
	DisputeLost          DisputeStatus = "lost"
	DisputeAccepted      DisputeStatus = "accepted"
	DisputeClosed        DisputeStatus = "closed"
)

func (s DisputeStatus) Valid() bool

type ErrNotRefundable struct{ Reason string }

func (e ErrNotRefundable) Error() string

type ErrRateLimited struct{ RetryAfter time.Duration }

func (e ErrRateLimited) Error() string

type Evidence struct {
	Text  string            `json:"text,omitempty"`
	Files map[string][]byte `json:"files,omitempty"`
}

type Factory func(cfg json.RawMessage, deps Deps) (Connector, error)

type HTTPOptions struct {
	Timeout     time.Duration
	MaxRetries  int
	Backoff     time.Duration
	Logger      *slog.Logger
	Secrets     []string
	RateLimit   RateLimit
	Observer    Observer
	Recorder    CallRecorder
	DenyPrivate bool
	LookupIP    func(ctx context.Context, host string) ([]net.IP, error)
	Base        http.RoundTripper
	Now         func() time.Time
	Sleep       func(ctx context.Context, d time.Duration) error
}

type Info struct {
	Name                     string           `json:"name"`
	Version                  string           `json:"version"`
	DisplayName              string           `json:"display_name"`
	Capabilities             []Capability     `json:"capabilities"`
	WebhookEvents            []string         `json:"webhook_events,omitempty"`
	ConfigSchema             json.RawMessage  `json:"config_schema"`
	Currencies               []string         `json:"currencies"`
	CheckoutHosts            *CheckoutHosts   `json:"checkout_hosts,omitempty"`
	SubscriptionCurrencies   []string         `json:"subscription_currencies,omitempty"`
	SubscriptionFixedMethods []string         `json:"subscription_fixed_methods,omitempty"`
	Methods                  []string         `json:"methods"`
	MerchantOfRecord         bool             `json:"merchant_of_record"`
	SubscriptionModes        []BillingMode    `json:"subscription_modes"`
	PreDebitPerAttempt       bool             `json:"pre_debit_per_attempt"`
	PreDebitMinHours         int              `json:"pre_debit_min_hours,omitempty"`
	DenyPrivateNetwork       bool             `json:"deny_private_network,omitempty"`
	MandateLimits            []MandateLimit   `json:"mandate_limits"`
	MandateSetupAmount       int64            `json:"mandate_setup_amount,omitempty"`
	MinChargeMinor           map[string]int64 `json:"min_charge_minor,omitempty"`
	RefundsVerificationDebit bool             `json:"refunds_verification_debit,omitempty"`
	RateLimit                RateLimit        `json:"rate_limit"`
	TestOnly                 bool             `json:"test_only,omitempty"`
}

func List() []Info

func (i Info) CanChangeSubscriptionAmount(method string) bool

func (i Info) Has(c Capability) bool

type KV interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, key string) ([]byte, bool, error)
	Set(ctx context.Context, key string, val []byte, ttl time.Duration) error
	Delete(ctx context.Context, key string) error
}

type Lister interface {
	ListPayments(ctx context.Context, tr TimeRange, cur Cursor) (Page[PaymentSnapshot], error)
	ListRefunds(ctx context.Context, tr TimeRange, cur Cursor) (Page[RefundSnapshot], error)
}

type MandateLimit struct {
	Method    string `json:"method"`
	Currency  string `json:"currency"`
	MaxAmount int64  `json:"max_amount"`
}

type MandateManager interface {
	CreateMandateCheckout(ctx context.Context, req MandateRequest) (CheckoutResult, error)
	FetchMandate(ctx context.Context, ref MandateRef) (MandateSnapshot, error)
	NotifyPreDebit(ctx context.Context, req PreDebitRequest) error
	ChargeMandate(ctx context.Context, req ChargeRequest) (PaymentSnapshot, error)
	RevokeMandate(ctx context.Context, ref MandateRef) error
}

type MandateRef struct {
	ProviderMandateID string `json:"provider_mandate_id"`
}

type MandateRequest struct {
	MandateID   string   `json:"mandate_id"`
	ProviderRef string   `json:"provider_ref"`
	Amount      int64    `json:"amount"`
	MaxAmount   int64    `json:"max_amount"`
	Currency    string   `json:"currency"`
	Method      string   `json:"method,omitempty"`
	ValidUntil  int64    `json:"valid_until,omitempty"`
	Customer    Customer `json:"customer"`
}

type MandateSnapshot struct {
	ProviderMandateID string           `json:"provider_mandate_id"`
	Status            string           `json:"status"`
	RawStatus         string           `json:"raw_status"`
	MaxAmount         int64            `json:"max_amount"`
	Currency          string           `json:"currency"`
	Method            string           `json:"method,omitempty"`
	ValidUntil        int64            `json:"valid_until,omitempty"`
	SetupPayment      *PaymentSnapshot `json:"setup_payment,omitempty"`
}

type MemKV struct {

}// contains filtered or unexported fields


func NewMemKV(now func() time.Time) *MemKV

func (m *MemKV) Delete(_ context.Context, key string) error

func (m *MemKV) Get(_ context.Context, key string) ([]byte, bool, error)

func (m *MemKV) Set(_ context.Context, key string, val []byte, ttl time.Duration) error

type NextAction struct {
	Kind      NextActionKind    `json:"kind"`
	URL       string            `json:"url,omitempty"`
	Fields    map[string]string `json:"fields,omitempty"`
	ScriptURL string            `json:"script_url,omitempty"`
	Options   map[string]any    `json:"options,omitempty"`
}

func (n NextAction) Allowed(h CheckoutHosts) error

func (n NextAction) Valid() bool

type NextActionKind string

const (
	ActionRedirect NextActionKind = "redirect"
	ActionFormPost NextActionKind = "form_post"
	ActionSDK      NextActionKind = "sdk"
)

type Notification struct {
	Kind         NotificationKind      `json:"kind"`
	EventID      string                `json:"event_id"`
	EventType    string                `json:"event_type"`
	OccurredAt   int64                 `json:"occurred_at,omitempty"`
	Payment      *PaymentSnapshot      `json:"payment,omitempty"`
	Refund       *RefundSnapshot       `json:"refund,omitempty"`
	Dispute      *DisputeSnapshot      `json:"dispute,omitempty"`
	Mandate      *MandateSnapshot      `json:"mandate,omitempty"`
	Subscription *SubscriptionSnapshot `json:"subscription,omitempty"`
	Payout       *PayoutSnapshot       `json:"payout,omitempty"`
}

func (n Notification) Validate() error

type NotificationKind string

const (
	NotifyPayment      NotificationKind = "payment"
	NotifyRefund       NotificationKind = "refund"
	NotifyDispute      NotificationKind = "dispute"
	NotifyMandate      NotificationKind = "mandate"
	NotifySubscription NotificationKind = "subscription"
	NotifyPayout       NotificationKind = "payout"
)

type OAuthConnector interface {
	OAuthDefaultScopes(cfg json.RawMessage) []string
	OAuthAuthorizeURL(cfg json.RawMessage, redirectURI, state string, scopes []string) (string, error)
	OAuthCallbackConfig(cfg json.RawMessage, params url.Values) (json.RawMessage, error)
	OAuthExchange(ctx context.Context, cfg json.RawMessage, redirectURI, code string) (OAuthResult, error)
}

type OAuthResult struct {
	RefreshToken string         `json:"refresh_token"`
	Scopes       []string       `json:"scopes,omitempty"`
	ExpiresIn    int64          `json:"expires_in,omitempty"`
	ConfigPatch  map[string]any `json:"config_patch,omitempty"`
}

type Observer func(RequestObservation)

type Page[T any] struct {
	Items []T    `json:"items"`
	Next  Cursor `json:"next,omitempty"`
}

type PaymentMethodDetails struct {
	Card   *CardDetails `json:"card,omitempty"`
	Bank   string       `json:"bank,omitempty"`
	Wallet string       `json:"wallet,omitempty"`
	UPI    *UPIDetails  `json:"upi,omitempty"`
}

func (d PaymentMethodDetails) Empty() bool

type PaymentRef struct {
	ProviderRef       string `json:"provider_ref,omitempty"`
	ProviderOrderID   string `json:"provider_order_id,omitempty"`
	ProviderPaymentID string `json:"provider_payment_id,omitempty"`
}

type PaymentSnapshot struct {
	ProviderRef       string               `json:"provider_ref,omitempty"`
	ProviderOrderID   string               `json:"provider_order_id,omitempty"`
	ProviderPaymentID string               `json:"provider_payment_id,omitempty"`
	SubscriptionID    string               `json:"subscription_id,omitempty"`
	Status            PaymentStatus        `json:"status"`
	RawStatus         string               `json:"raw_status"`
	Amount            int64                `json:"amount"`
	Currency          string               `json:"currency"`
	Method            string               `json:"method,omitempty"`
	MethodDetails     PaymentMethodDetails `json:"method_details,omitempty"`
	Fee               int64                `json:"fee,omitempty"`
	Tax               int64                `json:"tax,omitempty"`
	AmountRefunded    int64                `json:"amount_refunded,omitempty"`
	ErrorCode         string               `json:"error_code,omitempty"`
	ErrorMessage      string               `json:"error_message,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt         int64                `json:"created_at,omitempty"`
}

type PaymentStatus string

const (
	PaymentCreated        PaymentStatus = "created"
	PaymentRequiresAction PaymentStatus = "requires_action"
	PaymentProcessing     PaymentStatus = "processing"
	PaymentAuthorized     PaymentStatus = "authorized"
	PaymentSucceeded      PaymentStatus = "succeeded"
	PaymentFailed         PaymentStatus = "failed"
	PaymentCanceled       PaymentStatus = "canceled"
	PaymentExpired        PaymentStatus = "expired"
)

func (s PaymentStatus) Valid() bool

type PayoutRef struct {
	ProviderRef      string `json:"provider_ref,omitempty"`
	ProviderPayoutID string `json:"provider_payout_id,omitempty"`
}

type PayoutRequest struct {
	ProviderRef string      `json:"provider_ref"`
	Amount      int64       `json:"amount"`
	Currency    string      `json:"currency"`
	Beneficiary Beneficiary `json:"beneficiary"`
	Narration   string      `json:"narration,omitempty"`
}

type PayoutSnapshot struct {
	ProviderRef      string       `json:"provider_ref,omitempty"`
	ProviderPayoutID string       `json:"provider_payout_id"`
	Status           PayoutStatus `json:"status"`
	RawStatus        string       `json:"raw_status"`
	Amount           int64        `json:"amount"`
	Currency         string       `json:"currency"`
	UTR              string       `json:"utr,omitempty"`
	ErrorCode        string       `json:"error_code,omitempty"`
	ErrorMessage     string       `json:"error_message,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt        int64        `json:"created_at,omitempty"`
}

type PayoutStatus string

const (
	PayoutPending    PayoutStatus = "pending"
	PayoutProcessing PayoutStatus = "processing"
	PayoutSucceeded  PayoutStatus = "succeeded"
	PayoutFailed     PayoutStatus = "failed"
	PayoutReversed   PayoutStatus = "reversed"
)

type Payouter interface {
	CreatePayout(ctx context.Context, req PayoutRequest) (PayoutSnapshot, error)
	FetchPayout(ctx context.Context, ref PayoutRef) (PayoutSnapshot, error)
}

type PreDebitRequest struct {
	Mandate     MandateRef `json:"mandate"`
	ProviderRef string     `json:"provider_ref"`
	Amount      int64      `json:"amount"`
	Currency    string     `json:"currency"`
	DebitDate   int64      `json:"debit_date"`
}

type ProviderWebhookConfig struct{ URL string }

type ProviderWebhookResult struct {
	Secret  string
	Created bool
}

type RateLimit struct {
	RequestsPerSecond float64 `json:"requests_per_second"`
	Burst             int     `json:"burst"`
}

type RefundRef struct {
	ProviderRef       string `json:"provider_ref,omitempty"`
	ProviderRefundID  string `json:"provider_refund_id,omitempty"`
	ProviderPaymentID string `json:"provider_payment_id,omitempty"`
}

type RefundRequest struct {
	ProviderRef       string `json:"provider_ref"`
	ProviderPaymentID string `json:"provider_payment_id"`
	Amount            int64  `json:"amount"`
	Currency          string `json:"currency"`
	Reason            string `json:"reason,omitempty"`
}

type RefundSnapshot struct {
	ProviderRef       string       `json:"provider_ref,omitempty"`
	ProviderRefundID  string       `json:"provider_refund_id"`
	ProviderPaymentID string       `json:"provider_payment_id"`
	Status            RefundStatus `json:"status"`
	RawStatus         string       `json:"raw_status"`
	Amount            int64        `json:"amount"`
	Currency          string       `json:"currency"`
	CreatedAt         int64        `json:"created_at,omitempty"`
}

type RefundStatus string

const (
	RefundPending   RefundStatus = "pending"
	RefundSucceeded RefundStatus = "succeeded"
	RefundFailed    RefundStatus = "failed"
)

func (s RefundStatus) Valid() bool

type Refunder interface {
	Refund(ctx context.Context, req RefundRequest) (RefundSnapshot, error)
	FetchRefund(ctx context.Context, ref RefundRef) (RefundSnapshot, error)
}

type RequestObservation struct {
	Method   string        `json:"method"`
	Status   int           `json:"status,omitempty"`
	Duration time.Duration `json:"duration"`
	Outcome  string        `json:"outcome"`
}

type ReturnRequest struct {
	ProviderRef string              `json:"provider_ref"`
	Method      string              `json:"method"`
	Query       map[string][]string `json:"query,omitempty"`
	Form        map[string][]string `json:"form,omitempty"`
	Headers     map[string][]string `json:"headers,omitempty"`
	Body        []byte              `json:"body,omitempty"`
}

func (r ReturnRequest) Param(key string) string

type ReturnResult struct {
	ProviderRef       string `json:"provider_ref"`
	ProviderOrderID   string `json:"provider_order_id,omitempty"`
	ProviderPaymentID string `json:"provider_payment_id,omitempty"`
}

type SettlementItem struct {
	Kind              string `json:"kind"`
	ProviderPaymentID string `json:"provider_payment_id,omitempty"`
	ProviderRefundID  string `json:"provider_refund_id,omitempty"`
	Amount            int64  `json:"amount"`
	Fee               int64  `json:"fee"`
	Tax               int64  `json:"tax"`
}

type SettlementSnapshot struct {
	ProviderSettlementID string           `json:"provider_settlement_id"`
	Amount               int64            `json:"amount"`
	Fees                 int64            `json:"fees"`
	Tax                  int64            `json:"tax"`
	Currency             string           `json:"currency"`
	Status               string           `json:"status"`
	UTR                  string           `json:"utr,omitempty"`
	SettledAt            int64            `json:"settled_at,omitempty"`
	Items                []SettlementItem `json:"items,omitempty"`
}

type Settler interface {
	ListSettlements(ctx context.Context, tr TimeRange) ([]SettlementSnapshot, error)
}

type SubscriptionManager interface {
	CreateSubscriptionCheckout(ctx context.Context, req SubscriptionRequest) (CheckoutResult, error)
	FetchSubscription(ctx context.Context, ref SubscriptionRef) (SubscriptionSnapshot, error)
	CancelSubscription(ctx context.Context, ref SubscriptionRef, atPeriodEnd bool) error
	UpdateSubscriptionAmount(ctx context.Context, ref SubscriptionRef, amount int64) error
}

type SubscriptionRef struct {
	ProviderSubscriptionID string `json:"provider_subscription_id"`
}

type SubscriptionRequest struct {
	SubscriptionID string            `json:"subscription_id"`
	ProviderRef    string            `json:"provider_ref"`
	Amount         int64             `json:"amount"`
	Currency       string            `json:"currency"`
	Interval       string            `json:"interval"`
	IntervalCount  int               `json:"interval_count"`
	TotalCount     int               `json:"total_count,omitempty"`
	StartAt        int64             `json:"start_at,omitempty"`
	Description    string            `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Customer       Customer          `json:"customer"`
	Metadata       map[string]string `json:"metadata,omitempty"`
}

type SubscriptionSnapshot struct {
	ProviderSubscriptionID string `json:"provider_subscription_id"`
	ProviderRef            string `json:"provider_ref,omitempty"`
	Status                 string `json:"status"`
	RawStatus              string `json:"raw_status"`
	Amount                 int64  `json:"amount"`
	Currency               string `json:"currency"`
	CurrentPeriodStart     int64  `json:"current_period_start,omitempty"`
	CurrentPeriodEnd       int64  `json:"current_period_end,omitempty"`
}

type TimeRange struct {
	From int64 `json:"from"`
	To   int64 `json:"to"`
}

type UPIDetails struct {
	PayerAccountType string `json:"payer_account_type,omitempty"`
}

type URLs interface {
	ReturnURL(providerRef string) string
	WebhookURL() string
}

type WebhookConfigurator interface {
	ConfigureWebhook(ctx context.Context, cfg ProviderWebhookConfig) (ProviderWebhookResult, error)
}

type WebhookEventIDer interface {
	WebhookEventID(req WebhookRequest) (id string, ok bool)
}

type WebhookRequest struct {
	Method     string              `json:"method"`
	Headers    map[string][]string `json:"headers"`
	Query      map[string][]string `json:"query,omitempty"`
	Body       []byte              `json:"body"`
	ReceivedAt int64               `json:"received_at"`
}

func (w WebhookRequest) Header(name string) string

type Fixtures struct {
	Config                           json.RawMessage
	Now                              time.Time
	Ref                              connector.PaymentRef
	Statuses                         []StatusCase
	Webhooks                         WebhookFixtures
	Return                           *ReturnFixtures
	Checkout                         connector.CheckoutRequest
	CheckoutHandler                  http.Handler
	CheckNextAction                  func(t *testing.T, na connector.NextAction)
	OAuth                            *OAuthFixtures
	ConnectionOK, ConnectionRejected http.Handler
}

type OAuthFixtures struct {
	RedirectURI string
	Code        string
	Handler     http.Handler
}

type ReturnFixtures struct {
	Valid    connector.ReturnRequest
	Tampered connector.ReturnRequest
	Want     connector.ReturnResult
}

type StatusCase struct {
	Raw        string
	WantRaw    string
	Want       connector.PaymentStatus
	WantAmount int64
	Handler    http.Handler
}

type URLs struct{ Base string }

func (u URLs) ReturnURL(ref string) string

func (u URLs) WebhookURL() string

type WebhookFixtures struct {
	Valid            connector.WebhookRequest
	WrongSecret      connector.WebhookRequest
	SignatureHeaders []string
	Stale            *connector.WebhookRequest
}

const (

)

type Dispute struct {
	ID        string    `json:"id"`
	PaymentID string    `json:"payment_id"`
	AttemptID string    `json:"attempt_id"`
	Amount    int64     `json:"amount"`
	Currency  string    `json:"currency"`
	Reason    string    `json:"reason"`
	Status    string    `json:"status"`
	Stage     string    `json:"stage"`
	DueBy     time.Time `json:"due_by"`
	Source    string    `json:"source"`
	Version   int64     `json:"version"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

type DisputeEvent struct {
	Event   EventInfo       `json:"event"`
	Dispute Dispute         `json:"dispute"`
	Raw     json.RawMessage `json:"raw"`
}

type EventInfo struct {
	Type          string `json:"type"`
	OrgID         string `json:"org_id"`
	AppID         string `json:"app_id"`
	Mode          string `json:"mode"`
	ObjectType    string `json:"object_type"`
	ObjectID      string `json:"object_id"`
	ObjectVersion int64  `json:"object_version"`
}

type Invoice struct {
	ID             string    `json:"id"`
	Number         string    `json:"number"`
	PaymentID      string    `json:"payment_id"`
	SubscriptionID string    `json:"subscription_id"`
	IssuedAt       time.Time `json:"issued_at"`
	SupplyType     string    `json:"supply_type"`
	PlaceOfSupply  string    `json:"place_of_supply"`
	Currency       string    `json:"currency"`
	Taxable        int64     `json:"taxable"`
	CGST           int64     `json:"cgst"`
	SGST           int64     `json:"sgst"`
	IGST           int64     `json:"igst"`
	Total          int64     `json:"total"`
}

type InvoiceEvent struct {
	Event   EventInfo       `json:"event"`
	Invoice Invoice         `json:"invoice"`
	Raw     json.RawMessage `json:"raw"`
}

type Option func(*App)

func WithConnectorHTTP(f func(pa store.ProviderAccount, info connector.Info, secretValues []string) *http.Client) Option

func WithEmitter(e events.Emitter) Option

func WithLogger(l *slog.Logger) Option

func WithVerifiers(f inbound.VerifierFunc) Option

type Payment struct {
	ID             string            `json:"id"`
	Status         string            `json:"status"`
	Kind           string            `json:"kind"`
	Amount         int64             `json:"amount"`
	Currency       string            `json:"currency"`
	AmountReceived int64             `json:"amount_received"`
	AmountRefunded int64             `json:"amount_refunded"`
	OrderRef       string            `json:"order_ref"`
	Description    string            `json:"description"`
	CustomerID     string            `json:"customer_id"`
	Metadata       map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	Flags          []string          `json:"flags"`
	ExpiresAt      time.Time         `json:"expires_at"`
	CreatedAt      time.Time         `json:"created_at"`
	Version        int64             `json:"version"`
}

type PaymentEvent struct {
	Event     EventInfo       `json:"event"`
	Payment   Payment         `json:"payment"`
	Reason    string          `json:"reason"`
	AttemptID string          `json:"attempt_id"`
	Raw       json.RawMessage `json:"raw"`
}

type Refund struct {
	ID          string    `json:"id"`
	PaymentID   string    `json:"payment_id"`
	AttemptID   string    `json:"attempt_id"`
	Amount      int64     `json:"amount"`
	Currency    string    `json:"currency"`
	Status      string    `json:"status"`
	Reason      string    `json:"reason"`
	InitiatedBy string    `json:"initiated_by"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

type RefundEvent struct {
	Event         EventInfo       `json:"event"`
	Refund        Refund          `json:"refund"`
	FailureReason string          `json:"failure_reason"`
	Raw           json.RawMessage `json:"raw"`
}

type RouteAccount struct {
	ID        string `json:"id"`
	Connector string `json:"connector"`
	Name      string `json:"name"`
}

type RouteRequest struct {
	AppID    string            `json:"app_id"`
	Mode     string            `json:"mode"`
	Currency string            `json:"currency"`
	Country  string            `json:"country"`
	Amount   int64             `json:"amount"`
	Purpose  string            `json:"purpose"`
	Metadata map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	Accounts []RouteAccount    `json:"accounts"`
}

type Subscription struct {
	ID                 string            `json:"id"`
	Status             string            `json:"status"`
	BillingMode        string            `json:"billing_mode"`
	CustomerID         string            `json:"customer_id"`
	Amount             int64             `json:"amount"`
	Currency           string            `json:"currency"`
	Interval           string            `json:"interval"`
	IntervalCount      int               `json:"interval_count"`
	CurrentPeriodStart time.Time         `json:"current_period_start"`
	CurrentPeriodEnd   time.Time         `json:"current_period_end"`
	RenewalsDone       int               `json:"renewals_done"`
	CancelAtPeriodEnd  bool              `json:"cancel_at_period_end"`
	Metadata           map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	Version            int64             `json:"version"`
}

type SubscriptionEvent struct {
	Event        EventInfo       `json:"event"`
	Subscription Subscription    `json:"subscription"`
	Reason       string          `json:"reason"`
	Raw          json.RawMessage `json:"raw"`
}


package jsvm // import "github.com/velixio/paymux/pkg/jsvm"

const (
	DefaultCallTimeout  = 2 * time.Second
	DefaultFetchTimeout = 5 * time.Second
	DefaultMaxBody      = 1 << 20
	DefaultPollEvery    = 10 * time.Second
	DefaultPoolSize     = 4
	DefaultMaxMemory    = 128 << 20
)

type Options struct {
	Dir          string
	HTTPClient   *http.Client
	AllowedHosts []string
	Logger       *slog.Logger
	OnError      func(hook string, err error)
	PoolSize     int
	CallTimeout  time.Duration
	FetchTimeout time.Duration
	MaxBody      int64
	MaxMemory    int64
	PollEvery    time.Duration
}

type Runtime struct {

}// contains filtered or unexported fields

func (r *Runtime) Call(ctx context.Context, hook string, event any) error

func (r *Runtime) Changed() bool

func (r *Runtime) Close()

func (r *Runtime) Has(hook string) bool

func (r *Runtime) Hooks() []string

func (r *Runtime) Reload() error

func (r *Runtime) Route(ctx context.Context, req any) ([]string, error)

func (r *Runtime) Watch(ctx context.Context)
